descriptionHtml:
106.5 × 81.5cm. A bolster all round. A front they step over.

Easedale is an XL orthopaedic dog sofa bed, 106.5 × 81.5 × 16.5cm, with an egg-crate foam core, a waterproof liner and a non-slip base. The bolster runs round all four sides with the front section dropped low.

The first thing you notice is not a limp. It is the pause. They walk up to the bed, stand a second longer than they used to, then get in heavily rather than step in. On a hard floor the back feet slide while they do it.

Dropping the front section takes the climb out of it, and the non-slip base stops the bed travelling when they land.

What they get

  • A bolster on all four sides: Something to press a shoulder or hip into whichever way they end up.
  • A lowered front section: The entry edge drops, so stepping in takes nothing out of them.
  • A profiled egg-crate foam core: Profiling so the load is not all on the hips.
  • A waterproof liner around the foam: Wet coats and accidents stop before they reach the core.
  • A non-slip base: No skating across the kitchen tiles when they get in.

Best for: older big dogs hesitating at the edge, slippy kitchen floors, and homes where accidents happen.

Why it is worth the money

£165 is a lot for a dog bed, so here is where it goes. The two details that decide how many years you get are invisible in a photograph, which is why cheaper beds leave them out: the waterproof liner around the foam, and the dropped front that keeps the bed usable as they stiffen. Add a non-slip base and an egg-crate core across 106.5 × 81.5cm.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

A four-sided bolster costs floor. The outside is 106.5 × 81.5cm and the raised sides take part of that, so a dog who sleeps flat out is happier on an open chaise.

XL, one size106.5 × 81.5 × 16.5Bolster on four sides with a lowered front entry

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up some of that. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Newlands is this design at 89 × 63.5cm. Easedale is for the big dog thinking about the step.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner. Air-dry everything fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

How low is the front?

The front section is dropped against the other three sides, so the way in is a step rather than a wall. We do not publish a figure for that drop and will not invent one. Ask us first if that decides it.

Will it slide on a tiled floor?

There is a non-slip base underneath, for the moment they get in, which is when a bed usually moves.
